decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core heat-transfer and air-cooler know-how, this product fits its strong absorptive capacity and broad installed base, so management would be more likely to refine and integrate it than withdraw it despite some portfolio pruning elsewhere.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build very directly on the firm's existing engineering, manufacturing and R&D capabilities, and in a growing German machinery context with active in-house research and cooperation, management would expect to keep improving and commercializing this product rather than drop it.
